summary: Verified BSA GRC bug fix: /admin/services Landing Page tab now exposes full CRUD UI for previously JSON-only fields (Pain Points, Benefits/Keunggulan, Social Proof rating+testimonials, FAQ, hero gallery). Logged in as admin, opened Kubah Masjid GRC (slug kubah-grc) editor -> Landing Page Ads (8 Elemen) tab. All 10 sections render with real seeded data. Add/remove flows work for Pain Points, Testimoni, FAQ. Rating input editable. Save via 'Simpan Landing Page' returns PUT /api/admin/services 200. After full reload + re-navigation, data persisted correctly (pp=3, benefits=6, testimonials=3, faqs=4 - unchanged from initial). Public /layanan/kubah-grc page renders matching Pain Points ('Apakah Anda Mengalami Masalah Ini?'), Keunggulan, Panitia testimonials, and FAQ sections. No console errors. No test data left behind (all TEST_ prefixed additions were removed before save).

issues: Repeatable add/delete buttons for painPoints/benefits/testimonials/faqs lack data-testid attributes (per policy interactive elements should have them). Currently only service-image-gallery-btn/service-hero-gallery-btn exist. Non-blocking but recommend adding e.g. add-painpoint-btn, remove-painpoint-btn-{idx}, add-testimoni-btn, etc. for future automated testing stability.

action_items: Optional: add data-testid attributes to the newly added add/remove buttons in app/admin/services/page.tsx for painPoints/benefits/testimonials/faqs (non-blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: app/admin/services/page.tsx is now 550+ lines - approaching the 700-line file-size guideline. Consider extracting each Landing Page section (PainPointsSection, BenefitsSection, TestimonialsSection, FaqSection) into its own component under components/admin/services/ for readability and reuse.

Inline arrow handlers in Value Prop section (lines 386-387) rebuild the full landingPage object on every keystroke - fine for small lists but could be pulled into helper functions similar to updatePainPoint/updateBenefit for consistency.
seed_data_creation: None. Any TEST_ prefixed pain point / testimonial / FAQ added during interaction tests were deleted in the same test run BEFORE the save; the final saved state matches the initial state exactly (pp=3, benefits=6, testimonials=3, faqs=4). Kubah GRC data is clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug reported by user (missing landing-page settings in admin editor for Kubah GRC) is confirmed FIXED. All 8 landing-page elements now editable via UI. Tests exercised add/remove for pain points, testimonials, and FAQ, plus save (PUT 200) and reload persistence. Public page cross-check on /layanan/kubah-grc renders all sections. Recommend main agent add data-testid attributes on the new add/remove buttons for future test stability; not required for this fix.
rca of the issue: RCA: The admin editor form (app/admin/services/page.tsx Landing Page tab) previously only had UI inputs for headline, hero image, valueProps, CTA, and guarantees. The DB schema and public component (components/sections/LandingPageService.tsx) already supported painPoints, benefits, socialProof (rating/reviews/projects/provinces/testimonials), faqs, and heroImages, but the form displayed a placeholder note 'edit via JSON directly' instead of real inputs. FIX (already applied by main agent): added new list-based CRUD sections with add/remove buttons and inputs mapped to the existing landingPage JSON fields; PUT /api/admin/services persists the full object round-trip. VERIFIED end-to-end via this testing iteration.
